title: 2-3 Zone: five defenders, one gap
axes: brief: x<0 = LEFT seen from half court, y from the baseline, rim (0,1.575,3.05); repo x = -brief x

roles.O1: Point (0, 8.90) with the ball: entry pass to the nail (A) / to the left wing (B, C); stays high (balance)
roles.O2: Left wing (-6.25, 5.90): spacing in A; catches and throws the DIRECT skip to O3 in B (late in C)
roles.O3: Right wing shooter (6.30, 5.90), 7.64 m from the rim (FIBA 6.75): catch-and-shoot three in B
roles.O4: Right short corner (5.45, 1.95), outside the restricted area: baseline cut behind X4 + layup (A); baseline fake that holds X4 (B)
roles.O5: Left slot (-3.60, 5.60): curved flash to the nail and catch (A); nail threat that holds X2 (B, C), never receives
roles.X1: Zone top-left: pinches the nail (A); closes to O2 during the flight O1 -> O2 (B)
roles.X2: Zone top-right: pinches the nail, active hand on O5 (A); sinks to the nail, recovers late to O3 after the skip (B)
roles.X3: Zone low-left: compresses to the rim (A); bump to the left wing, then back down (B)
roles.X4: Zone low-right = THE DECIDER: short corner (O4) or help; hesitates 0.2 s (A); held by O4's fake, late closeout (B)
roles.X5: Zone middle: protects the rim; steps up to the high post only AFTER O5's catch (A); stays home (B)

areas.X4: low-right (right block / short corner / right corner)

A.title: 2-3 zone (A): flash to the nail, X5 steps up, O4 cuts behind X4, high-low layup

claims.says: If the center steps up (after the catch)
X5 has stepped up to O5 when O5 passes
flash, entry, step up, cut, high-low, layup

B.title: 2-3 zone (B): O1 -> O2, DIRECT skip O2 -> O3, X2 and X4 late, three

claims.says: THREE points (feet behind the FIBA line at the release)
nobody can contest at the catch (brief sec. 8, 2.20 s)
One late step. (late contest, hands up, no contact)

C.title: 2-3 zone (C, too slow): same set as B, O2 holds, the zone resets, O3 is contested

claims.says: But pass slowly? The zone resets.

timing_adjustments_vs_brief: Brief event table times are previs targets (sec. 7, 8: 'adapt after simulating the rigs'). Pass speeds kept <= 12 m/s at the contact (qc-catch), runs <= 6 m/s and <= 22 m/s^2 (minimum-jerk moves, mj()):

A O5 flash: brief 0.15 -> 0.55 s for 3.05 m (7.6 m/s, ~40 m/s^2) -> S000 -> S030 (1.00 s, 6.0 m/s peak, 19 m/s^2); curved down to y ~5.2 (1.1 m under X1's pinch line) so O5 never crosses X1; stops at the nail, catch S031
A O1 -> O5: release S021 (0.70 s, brief 0.70), catch S031 (1.03 s, brief 1.04)
A X5 stands still until the catch (S031), then steps up to (-1.05, 4.45) at S051 (1.70 s; brief 'for example (-1.2, 4.65)' at 1.28 s: 1.44 m from rest in 0.25 s is not humanly possible)

A O4 cut starts S036 (1.20 s, brief 1.28) when X5 is committed; O5 -> O4 release S058 (1.93 s, brief 1.95), catch on the move S072 (2.40 s, brief 2.25: 4.7 m in 0.30 s would be 15.8 m/s, above the 12 m/s catch limit); layup S078 -> S096 (2.60 -> 3.20 s, brief 2.55 -> 3.30)
A X4 hesitation S039 -> S045 (0.20 s standing, brief 0.15-0.25 s), then the chase from BEHIND O4 (never in front of him, >= 1 m at the catch)

B skip O2 -> O3 DIRECT: release S044 (1.47 s, brief 1.05-1.30; O2 needs 0.5 s from the catch to load an overhead with both hands on the ball), catch S077 (2.57 s, brief 2.20): 12.5 m in 1.10 s overhead with an arc

B O3 catch-and-shoot: gather S077 -> S088, release S088 (2.93 s, brief 2.70), make S119 (3.97 s, brief 3.65-4.10). O3 is >= 1.8 m clear at the catch; X4's late closeout is ~1.1 m away, hands up, at the release (late contest, no contact): shown as a late step, never 'wide open'
B X1 closes out on O2 from the TOP (-5.35, 6.70), runs UNDER the O1 -> O2 lane a step behind the ball; X2 sinks UNDER the nail (0.50, 5.22), 0.7 m below the skip line
C (slow): identical to B to S034; O2 holds to S066 (+0.73 s vs B), skip S066 -> S099; X2 (1.1 m) and X4 arrive with the catch, O3 does not shoot

gaps.why: HERE: the gap lights up, the hook settles
the five areas finish their reveal
boxes slide with the ball; reset to READ 01
reset to READ 02 (ball to the wing)
the skip flies over the zone

music: in-house synth e2a_music.py cine_b, drop 17.93 (Layup), payoff 30.14 (THREE), -12 dB dip on 'But pass slowly?', no SFX

shots.name: HOOK: semi-top orbit of the whole 5v5, five zone areas rise in sequence (A 0.00)
RIGHT HERE: orbit continues and pushes to the nail, ring + RIGHT HERE on HERE (A 0.00)
THE 2-3: true top-down, X1/X2 TOP then X3/X4/X5 LOW + MIDDLE (A 0.00)
BOXES MOVE WITH THE BALL: top turning ~20 deg, O1 -> O2, the areas slide and overlap (B 0.00 -> 1.30)
READ 01 FLASH: O5 curls to the nail, X1/X2 pinch, O1 -> O5, catch (A 0.00 -> 1.10)
IF THE CENTER STEPS UP: low 3/4, X5 steps up after the catch, O4 starts behind X4 (A 1.10 -> 1.78)
LAYUP: baseline tracking of O4, O5 -> O4, catch, layup, net, +2 (A 1.78 -> 3.45)
SO THE ZONE SQUEEZES THE MIDDLE: freeze A 1.60, orbit, areas compress, high post red (A 1.60 frozen)
READ 02: reset, semi-top, O1 -> O2, the zone shifts to the ball (B 0.00 -> 0.93)
SKIP: courtside on O2, release 1.47 on SKIP, camera rises over the whole flight (B 0.95 -> 1.75)
TWO JOBS: half orbit on the weak side, freeze B 1.75, X4 fork RIM? / CLOSE?; resumes: X4 late, O3 catch 2.57, release 2.93
THREE POINTS: low shot of shooter + rim, flight, net, +3 (B 2.93 -> 4.30)
TOO SLOW: top-down, O2 holds 1.3 s, skip late, X2 / X4 there with the catch (C 1.10 -> 3.45)
YOUR CALL: NAIL lit, SKIP arc wing to wing, comment, logo; camera turns back to the hook frame (B 0.95 frozen)
